title: missing_part() silently returns zero ranges when mail-parser index is invalid
description: In parse.rs, build_part() calls missing_part() when a child part index is out of range in the mail-parser parts array. missing_part() returns a ParsedPart with header_range=(0,0) and body_range=(0,0). The warning is added to ParsedMessage.warnings but the returned ParsedPart looks structurally valid with content_type='application/octet-stream'. A caller who does not check warnings will call decode_body_value() on this part and get the first 0 bytes of the raw buffer (an empty string, no error). The real failure — that the part tree is incomplete — is invisible unless warnings is explicitly checked. No test covers this path.
close_reason: duplicate of MIME-72l.36 (same missing_part sentinel bug)
